title: The venture-defense capital wave - new primes, 'American Dynamism', and the revolving door
source: Public record: Anduril $5B Series H at $61B (May 2026, led by Thrive + a16z; prior $2.5B at $30.5B led by Founders Fund; in talks for ~$100B two-stage, secondary ~$100B by Sep 2026; revenue ~doubled to ~$2.25B in 2025; Arsenal-1 $900M/5M-sqft Ohio plant Mar 2026; >$11B raised total; Founders Fund's $1B Series G = its largest check ever); a16z 'American Dynamism' practice (launched 2023 $600M; ~$1.8B across two funds; Jan 2026 $15B raise incl. $1.176B defense/aerospace/manufacturing fund backing Anduril, Shield AI, Saronic, Castelion; GP Katherine Boyle); Palantir market cap ~$325B (Jun 2026); Shield AI $2B at $12.7B (Mar 2026). Anduril founded by Palantir alumni (Brian Schimpf, Matt Grimm) + Palmer Luckey (post-Oculus) - 'Palantir's spiritual successor'. Cluster bankrolled by Founders Fund / a16z / Peter Thiel network (Anduril, Shield AI, Saronic, Scale AI, Vannevar Labs, Skydio, Epirus). Overlay on the Palantir/In-Q-Tel/defense threads + the Musk Project_Meridian block; structural edges only (dollar/round figures in notes). HONESTY: valuations/rounds/revenue/dates = fact (the ~$100B is reported/secondary, labeled); 'AI military-industrial complex' is a cited critique (Artforum + observers), labeled; whether this is healthy industrial-base renewal OR venture hype riding geopolitics is CONTESTED (both presented); the founders-advising-Pentagon-procurement conflict (via Project_Meridian) is a labeled structural concern, not an allegation. No cabal - a documented, network-dense investment wave.
grade: per-edge in notes (fact | reported | contested | interpretation)

edges.notes: The exemplar new prime: $5B Series H at $61B (May 2026), in talks toward ~$100B (reported/secondary), revenue ~doubled to ~$2.25B (2025), $900M Arsenal-1 Ohio plant (Mar 2026), >$11B raised total. 'Defense tech' went from a VC taboo (2015) to a pitch advantage (2026) (fact; the ~$100B = reported).
Founders Fund (Thiel) led Anduril's $30.5B round and wrote a $1B Series G check - reported as its largest ever; the anchor of the Thiel-network defense bet (fact).
a16z has backed Anduril since 2019 and co-led the $61B Series H (May 2026) with Thrive Capital (fact).

'American Dynamism' is a16z's practice for 'companies building in the national interest' (space/defense/manufacturing/robotics) - launched 2023 ($600M), ~$1.8B across two funds, plus a $1.176B fund in the Jan 2026 $15B raise. GP Katherine Boyle (fact; 'national interest' framing is a16z's own).
Anduril is American Dynamism's flagship validation - a16z's foundational defense bet (fact).
Shield AI (autonomous flight) - $2B at $12.7B (Mar 2026) - in the American Dynamism / defense-tech portfolio (fact).
Saronic (autonomous naval vessels) is in the a16z American Dynamism defense portfolio alongside Anduril/Shield AI/Castelion (fact).
American Dynamism is the branded center of gravity for the venture-defense wave (fact).

Anduril is 'Palantir's spiritual successor' - founded 2017 by Palantir alumni Brian Schimpf + Matt Grimm with Palmer Luckey (post-Oculus); both named after Lord of the Rings objects. The Palantir diaspora seeding the new primes (fact).

Palantir (~$325B market cap, Jun 2026) is described as the 'public face' of the AI-driven military-industrial complex - the listed anchor of the cluster (fact of mcap; 'public face' = cited critique, labeled).
SpaceX is the most valuable American Dynamism-aligned company and a major defense contractor (Golden Dome) - the gravitational center of the cluster (fact).
Scale AI (military AI data/labeling; Meta took a large stake in 2025) sits in the defense-tech cluster alongside Vannevar Labs, Skydio, Epirus (fact of category).

The Thiel network (Palantir, Founders Fund, Anduril backing) is the connective tissue the cluster runs through - the 'deeper roster' behind the public face (fact of the network; cabal framing rejected - it is dense investment, not a proven directed scheme).

8VC (Joe Lonsdale, Palantir co-founder) is among the top defense-tech VCs (with Founders Fund, a16z, Lux, Shield Capital, General Catalyst) - the Palantir-founder capital recycling into new primes (fact).

In-Q-Tel (CIA venture arm, Palantir's early backer) + the NATO Innovation Fund are the government-adjacent capital feeding the same cluster - the public-money end of the wave (fact; ties the In-Q-Tel block).

The sector's single customer is the DoD; the wave rides a procurement-reform tailwind (faster software-style acquisition) + elevated geopolitical demand (Ukraine, Iran). Whether this is healthy industrial-base renewal or venture hype riding war is CONTESTED (both presented).

THE REVOLVING DOOR: the cluster's principals now help set DoD demand - Palmer Luckey (Anduril) + Elon Musk (SpaceX/xAI) co-direct the Pentagon's Project Meridian capabilities study. Founders of the supplier side advising on what the buyer should buy - the structural conflict the map flags (interpretation, labeled; cf spec-musk-project-meridian).
